title: Preserve the active sample when submission is unconfirmed
test_file_status: planned new file in existing tests/voice lane

evidence.observed: transition_sample returning {success:false,error:'rejected'} still produces 'marked complete and submitted for review' and clears the session.

user_impact: A technician hears that submission succeeded and loses their current sample even though the mocked submission was rejected.
implementation_scope: Check submission evidence before confirming a workflow change or clearing the session. Use an unconfirmed response when evidence is absent. Do not infer completion merely from an HTTP request returning.
acceptance: Rejected, empty and malformed responses preserve the sample ID and UID.
Successful feedback reflects the observed transition; only confirmed submission clears context.
Timeouts do not cause automatic duplicate submissions.
constraints: Change only the named source file and test file for implementation.
All verification uses synthetic fixtures and mocks; no live SENAITE writes or email.
Do not run jobs sharing a source file as concurrent writers.
duplicate_check: No selected source appears in any of 17 open PR file lists or 32 merged-since-2026-10-09 PR file lists in the saved GitHub snapshot.
